DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの資料について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss the documents you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この住宅ローンの相談案内を見て来ましたが、相談先がこちらの銀行で合っているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅ローン相談案内の発行銀行と現在窓口が同じか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I came after seeing this home loan consultation leaflet, but I want to check whether this is the right bank to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the bank that issued the home loan consultation leaflet is the bank at this counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表紙のお名前は「青波銀行」ですね。こちらは「山手銀行」の窓口です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The name on the cover is Aonami Bank. This is a Yamate Bank counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違う銀行へ来てしまったんですね。青波銀行の住宅ローン相談を希望して、この案内を持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青波銀行住宅ローン相談の希望と窓口相違を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I came to the wrong bank. I brought this leaflet because I wanted to discuss a home loan with Aonami Bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Express your wish to consult Aonami Bank about a home loan and show that you understand the counter is for a different bank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料をお返しします。青波銀行の問い合わせ先は、その表紙にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll return your leaflet. Is Aonami Bank's contact information on the cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下の方に電話番号がありました。この番号へ相談できる場所を尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表紙電話で相談場所を尋ねたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found a phone number near the bottom. I'd like to call it to ask where I can have a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to use the phone number on the cover to ask where consultations are available. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住宅ローンの案内のご相談は、その発行元の銀行へお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please contact the bank that issued the home loan leaflet about consultations relating to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今日はここで用紙を書き始めず、青波銀行へ電話してから向かいます。表紙が見えるように持ち直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当窓口で記入せず正銀行へ電話して向かうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I won't start filling out a form here today. I'll call Aonami Bank before going there. I'll hold the leaflet so the cover is visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not fill anything out at this counter and will call the correct bank before going there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、お預かりしている物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are we holding anything else of yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料だけです。返していただいた一冊を鞄へ入れました。行き先を確認できて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却資料一冊を保管し相談先確認に謝意を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just the leaflet. I've put the one copy you returned in my bag. Thank you for helping me confirm where to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have put away the one returned leaflet and thank them for helping you confirm where to consult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内された相談先へお問い合わせください。お足元にお気をつけて。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please contact the consultation office indicated. Watch your step. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のケーキをお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect a cake you reserved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、受取札が鞄に見当たりません。自分の名前と注文内容で、確認をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取札不明の本人予約を氏名内容で確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I can't find the collection slip in my bag. Could you check my own reservation using my name and order details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to check your own reservation by name and order details because you cannot find the collection slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と、ご予約のケーキを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your name and which cake you reserved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエンです。チョコレートのケーキで、上に六という数字を付けてもらう注文です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: チョコケーキと六数字の注文を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nguyen. It's a chocolate cake, and I ordered the number six on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you ordered a chocolate cake with the number six. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの予約ですね。ご注文の連絡を受けた画面は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is your reservation. Do you have the message confirming your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯にあります。この画面をお見せします。受取札は家に置いたかもしれないので、今はこの連絡だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯予約連絡を示し札が手元にないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's on my phone. I'll show you this screen. I may have left the collection slip at home, so this message is all I have now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the reservation message on your phone and say that you do not have the slip with you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。ケーキをお持ちしますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've confirmed it. Please wait here while I bring your cake.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。名前の文字も注文しました。箱を閉じる前に、数字と名前を見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱閉前に数字氏名表記を見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I also ordered lettering for the name. Could I see the number and name before you close the box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to see the number and written name before the box is closed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご確認いただけます。こちらが、お名前と六の数字です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Here are the name and the number six.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: どちらも合っています。これで受け取ります。受取札が家で見つかったら、もう受け取ったと分かるようにしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容一致と受取後札発見時の管理を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both are right. I'll take it. If I find the collection slip at home, I'll mark it so I know I've already collected the cake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the order is correct and explain how you will handle the slip if you find it after collection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。それでは、ケーキをお渡しします。楽しいお祝いになりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Here is your cake. I hope you have a lovely celebration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今からご一緒になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to join us now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。最後の動きだけでも参加したいです。もう始まっていますが、あと何回ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 体操最後だけ参加希望で残回数を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to join in even if it's only the last exercise. You've already started, but how many repetitions are left?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to join just the final exercise and ask how many repetitions remain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の動きは、あと二回です。こちらの空いた所でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are two more repetitions of this movement. Please watch from this open space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二回ですね。まず皆さんの動きを一回見て、そのあと一緒にできる分だけ参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残二回を確認し一回観察後参加すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two, then. I'll watch everyone do it once first, then join in as much as I can.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that two repetitions remain and say you will watch one before joining. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 終わったら、その場所で少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: When it's over, please wait there for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人は後ろで見ています。私が終わるまで、そこにいると伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人が後方待機することを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: All right. My friend is watching from the back. I told them to stay there until I finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your friend is waiting at the back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後の回が終わりました。ご参加いただけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That was the last repetition. Were you able to join in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。途中からでも、どんな雰囲気か分かりました。次は最初から参加したいので、集合の案内をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終了後の感想と次回最初から参加する案内希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Even though I joined partway through, I got a feel for it. I'd like to start from the beginning next time, so could I have information about where and when to gather?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your impressions after finishing and ask for gathering information so you can join from the beginning next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの紙に、次回の集合時刻があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The gathering time for next time is on this sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午前九時ですね。今日はこの案内を持ち帰り、友人と次の予定を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 九時集合案内を持ち帰り友人と予定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nine in the morning, then. I'll take this information home today and discuss our next plans with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take home the information about gathering at nine and discuss plans with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、またご都合のよい時にお越しください。ご参加ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come again whenever it suits you. Thank you for joining us. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お足元で、お困りのことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is something troubling you around your feet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 靴ひもがほどけました。しゃがむと鞄が邪魔なので、座って結べる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ほどけた靴紐を座って結べる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My shoelace has come undone. My bag gets in the way when I squat, so is there somewhere I can sit to tie it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can sit to tie your undone shoelace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのベンチで結び直せます。通る方へ足を出さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can retie it on this bench. Please avoid sticking your feet out into the path of people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人が先に出口へ歩いているので、結び直してから行くと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先行友人へ結び直してから行くと連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. My friend is already walking toward the exit, so I'll tell them I'll come after retying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell your friend who has gone ahead that you will come after retying your shoelace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物を下ろす時は、置き忘れないようお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you put your belongings down, please check that you don't leave them behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鞄を膝へ置きます。ひもが片方の靴の下へ入っていたので、引っ張る前に足を少し動かします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鞄を膝に置き、靴の下に入ったひもを足を動かして出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put my bag on my lap. The lace has gone under one shoe, so I'll move my foot a little before pulling it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put your bag on your lap and move your foot to free the lace beneath the shoe. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お急ぎでなければ、落ち着いてご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you aren't in a hurry, please take your time getting ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。乗るために急いでいるのではなく、駅を出て食事に行く所です。友人から待つと返事が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗車急ぎでなく食事へ行く途中で友人待機返信と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I'm not rushing to catch a train; I'm leaving the station to get something to eat. My friend has replied that they'll wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are going out to eat rather than hurrying to catch a train and that your friend has replied they will wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 結び終わりましたら、お荷物もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've tied it, please take your belongings too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 結べました。もう片方もほどけていません。鞄を持って、友人のいる出口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 左右紐を点検し鞄を持って友人の出口へ向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's tied. The other one hasn't come undone either. I'll take my bag and go to the exit where my friend is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked both shoelaces and will take your bag to the exit where your friend is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お足元にお気をつけてお進みください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please watch your step as you go. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域のことで、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the neighborhood?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 町内の回覧板を受け取りました。次の家が留守だったので、渡し方を相談できる方を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣宅不在のため町内回覧を渡す相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've received the neighborhood circular. The next household wasn't home, so I'd like to know whom I can ask about passing it on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult about passing on the neighborhood circular because the next household is absent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お住まいの地区と、回覧にある連絡先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me which district you live in and the contact information on the circular.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この地区です。紙の下に電話番号がありますが、誰の番号か読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地区と読めない番号表記を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is my district. There's a phone number at the bottom of the sheet, but I can't read whose number it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your district and the unreadable label for the phone number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは地域の担当への連絡先です。回覧の順番と不在時の扱いをお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the contact number for the person responsible for the area. You can ask about the circulation order and what to do when someone is out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。郵便受けへ入れればよいか迷いましたが、雨でぬれそうだったので持ち帰りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 雨で濡れる懸念から投函せず持帰ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I wasn't sure whether to put it in the mailbox, but I brought it home because it looked as though it would get wet in the rain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought it home without putting it in the mailbox because you were concerned it would get wet in the rain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経緯もお伝えください。回覧板は今お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain those circumstances too. Do you have the circular with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ほかの人がまだ読む紙なので、私の家で止まっていることも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回覧現物を示し他人未読で自宅滞留中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Other people still need to read these papers, so I'd also like to explain that they're being held up at my house.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the circular and say that it is still at your house while others have yet to read it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ連絡する時は、回覧の見出しもお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you contact the person responsible, please tell them the circular's heading too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この見出しを読みます。次の方への渡し方が決まるまで、紙を乾いたまま保管しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見出しを伝え渡し方判明まで乾いた状態で保管すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read out this heading. I'll keep the papers dry until I know how to pass them to the next person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will give the heading and keep the papers dry until you know how to hand them on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの連絡先へご相談ください。お越しいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please ask at this contact number. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の前に、確認したいお持ち物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the examination, is there anything you brought that you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の名札を首から下げたまま来ました。外して鞄へしまってから、検査の案内を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事名札を外して鞄へしまう時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come still wearing my work name badge around my neck. May I take it off and put it in my bag before listening to the examination instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for time to remove your work name badge and put it in your bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どうぞ。病院でお渡しした名札ではなく、ご自身の物ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course. It's your own badge, rather than one the hospital gave you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。勤務先の名札です。ひもを頭から外すと髪に引っかかるので、留め具を開いて外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先私物で髪に引掛からぬよう留具で外すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It's my workplace badge. Pulling the strap over my head catches my hair, so I'll open the clasp to remove it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is your personal workplace badge and that you will use the clasp to remove it without catching your hair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外した物は、ご自身のお荷物へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put whatever you remove into your own belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外せました。カードをひもから抜かずに一緒に巻き、鞄の小さいポケットへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カードと紐を一緒にまとめ小ポケットへ収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've taken it off. I'll wind the card and strap together without removing the card from the strap, then put them in the small pocket of my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will gather the card and strap together and put them in the small pocket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査で必要な準備は、担当から改めて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the preparations required for the examination separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。仕事の名札を外したので、ほかに外す物があるかも、説明を聞いて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査で他に外す物があるか担当説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Now that I've removed my work badge, I'd like to hear the explanation and check whether there's anything else I need to remove.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to hear the staff member's explanation about whether anything else must be removed for the examination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の紙は、お手元に残してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you still have the reception sheet with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、紙は持っています。名札だけ鞄へしまえたので、この紙を持って説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付紙は手元に保持し説明待機すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I have the sheet. I've put only the name badge in my bag, so I'll hold this sheet and wait for the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you are keeping the reception sheet with you and waiting for the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当がご案内します。お持ち物をお忘れなく。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then the person in charge will guide you. Please don't forget your belongings. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その音は、お持ちのブザーでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that sound coming from your personal alarm?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。鞄を落とした時に鳴り始めました。誰かに追われたのではなく、私が落として作動させてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落下で防犯ブザー作動し追跡被害ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It started sounding when I dropped my bag. Nobody was chasing me; I accidentally set it off by dropping it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that dropping it activated the personal safety alarm and that you were not being chased. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外れた部品は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the part that came off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さい部品です。戻す所が分からず、音を止められないままこちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外れた部品を示し戻し場所不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this little part. I couldn't find where to put it back, so I came here while the alarm was still sounding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the detached part and say that you do not know where to reinsert it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機種を確認します。いったんこちらの台へ置いて、部品も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the model. Please put it on this counter for now and show me the part too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 置きます。鞄につけたまま強く引っ張るのでなく、全体を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 台へ置き鞄から強引に引かず全体確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put it down. I'd like you to look at the whole thing instead of pulling hard on it while it's attached to my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Place it on the counter and ask for the whole alarm to be checked without pulling it forcefully from the bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この部品を元の位置へ戻す形です。私が位置を示しますので、ご自身でゆっくり戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: This part goes back in its original position. I'll point out where, so please put it back slowly yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻せました。音が止まりました。途中で心配して声をかけてくれた人へ、自分で落としたと説明しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部品を戻して音停止し心配した人にも事情説明済と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've put it back. The sound has stopped. I explained to someone who spoke to me out of concern on the way that I had dropped it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that replacing the part stopped the sound and that you have already explained what happened to the person who was concerned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今後使う前に、取扱説明で作動と停止の方法を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before using it again, please check the instructions for how to activate and stop it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は鞄の内側へしまい、家で説明を読みます。また外へ付ける前に、部品が落ちないよう状態を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持帰り説明を読み再装着前に状態を確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I'll put it inside my bag today and read the instructions at home. Before attaching it outside again, I'll check its condition so the part won't fall off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take it home, read the instructions, and check its condition before reattaching it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、落ち着いてご準備ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take your time getting ready. Have a safe journey home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお手紙を、お出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。厚くなってポストの口に入りませんでした。押し込まずに持ってきたので、窓口で出せるか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厚封筒がポストに入らず未強押で窓口差出可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It was too thick to fit through the postbox slot. I brought it here without forcing it in, so please check whether I can send it at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can post the thick envelope at the counter after it would not fit in the postbox and you did not force it in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで大きさと重さを確認します。どのような物が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check its dimensions and weight here. What is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書類と、折れないように入れた台紙です。ポストへ入れようとした時も、封筒は曲げていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類台紙入りで封筒未曲げと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Documents and a backing board to stop them bending. I didn't bend the envelope when I tried putting it in the postbox either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it contains documents and backing board and that you have not bent the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒の形を保ったまま量ります。台紙を外すご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll weigh it while keeping its shape. Would you like to remove the backing board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。書類が折れないようにしたいので、このままの大きさで料金を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保護台紙を外さず現在サイズの料金確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I want to keep the documents from bending, so I'd like to know the postage for it at this size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the postage at its current size without removing the protective backing board. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この状態での料金は五百円です。窓口でお預かりできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The postage in this condition is five hundred yen. We can accept it at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 五百円ですね。その金額でお願いします。貼った切手もあるので、追加で払う額を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 架空料金五百円で発送を頼み既貼付切手との差額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Five hundred yen, then. Please send it at that rate. There are already stamps on it, so please tell me how much extra I need to pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to send it at the fictional rate of five hundred yen and ask for the difference after the stamps already affixed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 貼ってある切手は三百五十円分ですので、あと百五十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The stamps already on it total three hundred and fifty yen, so you need another hundred and fifty yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、百五十円を払います。宛先はこのままで、封も閉じています。この窓口から出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足百五十円を払い宛先封緘維持で窓口差出すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll pay a hundred and fifty yen. The address will stay as it is, and the envelope is sealed. I'll send it from this counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay the remaining hundred and fifty yen and post it at the counter with the address and seal unchanged. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お預かりします。ご来局いただき、ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take it. Thank you for visiting the post office. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見つかったカードについて、窓口で確認されたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to check at the counter about the card you found, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくしたと思って停止をお願いしましたが、家の書類の間から見つかりました。再発行を頼む前に知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止依頼カード発見を再発行申込前に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I'd lost it and asked for it to be suspended, but I found it among some papers at home. I'd like to let you know before requesting a replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report finding the card you requested to suspend before applying for a replacement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止のご連絡をされた時の控えは、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the record from when you contacted us to suspend it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。昨日の受付番号をここに書きました。見つかったカードも、そのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日受付番号と現カードを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I've written yesterday's reference number here. I've also brought the card I found as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present yesterday's reference number and the actual card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の確認をして、現在の状態を担当が調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: After confirming your identity, the staff member will check its current status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。今朝見つかりましたが、まだ機械へ入れたり、支払いに使ったりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝発見後にATM決済未使用と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I found it this morning, but I haven't put it into a machine or used it for payment yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not used the card in an ATM or for payment since finding it this morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お探しになった場所に、ほかのカードもありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Were there any other cards where you looked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古いカードも一枚ありました。今使っていた方を確かめて持ってきたので、こちらを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同所の旧カードと区別し現使用対象を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was one old card too. I checked which one I had been using and brought it, so please look at this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish it from the old card found in the same place and show the card you were currently using. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状態の確認後に、今後のお手続きをご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once we've checked its status, we'll explain the next steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。見つかったことだけで使い始めず、昨日の連絡の続きとして相談します。本人確認の書類も出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止連絡継続相談として状態確認を待ち本人書類を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I won't start using it just because I found it. I'll discuss this as a continuation of yesterday's call. I'll also present my identification documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the status check as a continuation of your suspension report and present identification documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へおつなぎします。カードと控えをお手元にお持ちください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll put you in touch with the person in charge. Please keep the card and reference record with you. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの切り身を二枚でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like two of these fish fillets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。別々の料理に使うので、一枚ずつ包んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚切身を別料理用に一枚ずつ包むよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll use them in separate dishes, so could you wrap each one individually?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to have the two fillets wrapped individually for separate dishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一枚ずつ包めます。二枚とも同じ切り身ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can wrap them separately. Both are the same kind of fillet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。一枚は夕食に、もう一枚は別の料理用です。冷蔵庫へ入れる時も、分けたままにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同魚を夕食と別料理に使い保管も分けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. One is for dinner and the other for a different dish. I'd like to keep them separate when I put them in the refrigerator too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the same fish will be used for dinner and another dish and that you want to store them separately too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの二つに分けてお渡しします。お持ち帰りの袋はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll give them to you in these two separate packages. Do you have a bag to take them home in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 保冷袋があります。ただ、ほかにパンも買うので、魚の汁が外へ出ないよう入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参保冷袋とパンがあり魚汁漏れを心配する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an insulated bag. But I'll also buy bread, so I want to pack the fish so its juices don't leak out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have brought an insulated bag and will also have bread, and express concern about leaking fish juices. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包みの口を閉じてお渡しします。パンとは別の袋へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll close the packages before handing them over. Please put them in a different bag from the bread.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。魚だけを保冷袋へ、パンは手提げへ入れます。二つの包みはどちらも同じ重さですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 魚とパン別袋に入れ二包み重さが同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I'll put just the fish in the insulated bag and the bread in my tote bag. Do the two packages weigh the same?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the fish and bread in separate bags and ask whether the two packages have the same weight. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 少しずつ重さが違います。こちらの表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Their weights differ slightly. Please look at these labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大きい方が夕食用ですね。重さを見て料理を分けます。二包みで会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を見て大切身を夕食用にし二包み会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The larger one is for dinner, then. I'll decide which dish to use each for by checking the weights. Please ring up the two packages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Look at the labels, choose the larger fillet for dinner, and ask to pay for the two packages. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。それでは、この二包みをお持ちください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here are your two packages. Thank you for shopping with us.
